== Course of events ==

The Army of Revolt surrendered in the Emerald City, bringing the uprising to a close. With the fighting ended, the jewels stolen during the revolt were returned, restoring what had been taken from the city. Tip, present through the conflict's resolution, saw the moment culminate in the crowning of Ozma as queen of the Emerald City, with the Queen taking her place at the head of the restored throne.

This resolution closed the chapter of rebellion and cleared the way for those gathered in its wake to turn to new matters, from the fate of the Gump that had served through the campaign to the plans of those preparing to leave the Emerald City for their own affairs.
